SEI SAADIYAT — FIRST SALES RELEASE

Aldar has announced Sei Saadiyat in Saadiyat Cultural District. Phase one brings 265 homes across two buildings, with 1–3 bedroom apartments and 2-bedroom lofts. Sales are scheduled to open on 16 September 2026.

Broker listings indicate prices from AED 2.95 million, a 50/50 plan and Q4 2030 handover; these commercial terms have not yet been confirmed in an accessible Aldar price list.

TALAY — FIRST VILLAS AT MARSA AL SAADIYAT

Aldar has announced 351 standalone 4–6 bedroom villas on Saadiyat Island. Sales open on 23 September 2026.

This is the first named residential release within the Marsa Al Saadiyat masterplan — a new opportunity for buyers following the island's next waterfront district.

Developer-confirmed starting prices, booking terms and handover were not included in the announcement checked.

modon-wadeem-gardens:2026-09-14-broker-l.body:
WADEEM GARDENS — HUDAYRIYAT ISLAND

Broker intelligence: Modon's new villa collection is being marketed with 4, 5 and 6 bedrooms across three gated clusters.

Brokers quote prices from AED 8.7 million and a refundable AED 50,000 EOI. Advertised terms include 25/75 payments, 5% on reservation and Q2 2031 handover, with financing subject to approval. These figures are not yet independently developer-confirmed.

A new family-villa option in Abu Dhabi's major island development programme.

Image: project marketing render.

TALAY & TALAY BEACH — COLLECTION UPDATE
Aldar | Marsa Al Saadiyat, Abu Dhabi

An 18 September sales briefing clarifies the previously announced 351-villa release:
• Talay: 167 villas; indicated handover Q4 2029.
• Talay Beach: 184 villas; indicated handover Q4 2030.
Both offer 4–6 bedroom standalone villas. These collection details remain sales-briefing/broker intelligence.

Aldar confirms sales open on 23 September 2026.
Talay is indicated from AED 13.5m with 50/50 payments; final developer terms are not independently verified. Talay Beach pricing remains unconfirmed. Verified booking/EOI amount not found.

Why it matters: different delivery targets when selecting a collection.
Confidence: high on the official sales date; medium on collection-specific details and terms.

YAS RIVA RESERVE — SALES-DATE UPDATE
Aldar | Northeast Yas Island, Abu Dhabi

New details beyond our earlier pre-launch alert: Gulf News reports sales opening on 26 September 2026, with 292 four- to six-bedroom villas. It says 45 homes sit directly on the waterway, with an optional private pontoon.

Reported starting price: AED 8.5m (unconfirmed by the developer). This is a media indication, not an independently verified Aldar price list. Payment plan, booking/EOI and handover remain unverified.

Why it matters: a near-term family-villa release with a limited waterfront subset, separate from the original Yas Riva community.
Confidence: medium-high on reported project details; developer confirmation of commercial terms awaited.

Confidence: high on identity; medium on broker launch and commercial details.

TALAY — ALLOCATION-TIMING UPDATE
Aldar | Marsa Al Saadiyat, Abu Dhabi

A developer-partner briefing clarifies Aldar's published 23 September sales commencement: non-resident allocations are indicated for 24 September and the public launch for 25 September.

The release comprises 351 standalone 4–6BR villas across Talay and Talay Beach. Broker material indicates Talay from AED 13.5m with 50/50 payments and Q4 2029 handover; Talay Beach is indicated for Q4 2030. These commercial terms remain unverified against final Aldar sales documents, and Talay Beach pricing is still unknown.

Why it matters: buyers now have a clearer allocation sequence for the first Marsa Al Saadiyat villa release.
Confidence: high on project and official sales commencement; medium-high on the 24/25 September allocation sequence; commercial terms remain indicative.
